title: Pytania i odpowiedzi KSeF 2.0 - KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur)
content:
Source: KSeF podatki.gov.pl - FAQ i zasady obowiązywania
URL: https://ksef.podatki.gov.pl/pytania-i-odpowiedzi-ksef-20/?category=&query=terytorium+kraju
- The page "Pytania i odpowiedzi KSeF 2.0" on KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur) provides a living FAQ about KSeF 2.0, created with input from businesses, integrators, and participants of webinars and consultations.
- It groups questions by categories and encourages ongoing Q&A to expand the knowledge base.
- Key topics include basic information about KSeF, what the system is, and how to use it.
- Important note: KSeF is a system for issuing, sending, receiving, and storing structured invoices, with a rollout starting February 1, 2026 to cover all entities in Poland. The page emphasizes updates and participation in discussions to reflect new questions and use cases.
- The page is a searchable FAQ with sections like “Podstawowe informacje o KSeF” and “Co to jest KSeF?” and guidance on usage.
